details.description: Only laundry detergents are not enough for removing tough stains, and stains often remain on clothes even after a wash with the best of detergents. Vanish is an expert laundry additive that specialises in the removal of tough stains in only 1 wash with its active oxygen formula. It also whitens your whites and brightens your coloured garments with its active brighteners to give you dry-cleaning-like results for your everyday clothes.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Pretreat (Really Tough Stains): Apply Vanish on stain, rub gently and wait (max. 10 minutes, do not allow Vanish to dry on fabric), Wash as usual.
2. Soak (Tough stains): Add 100ml to 5L of water, For whites: Leave to soak for max 6 hours, For colours: Leave to soak for max 1 hour, Wash as usual or rinse thoroughly.
3. In wash (Normal stains): Add 100ml on top of detergent and wash as usual.

title: Oxi Action Crystal White Fabric Whitener Powder

details.description: White clothes often lose their shine and become dull over time. When it comes to white clothes, it’s a challenge to remove tough stains and keep them shining like new wash after wash. Vanish, gives your white clothes shine like new even after 50 washes. Its chlorine bleach-free oxi action gives brighter whites & removes tough stains without causing damage. Vanish, is an expert fabric whitener with added optical brighteners that brighten your whites giving them shine like new even after 50 washes. It removes even the toughest dried-on stains, ensuring a stain-free laundry and its chlorine bleach-free formula ensures no damage or dullness is caused even after repeated washes. It is safe to be used on all fabrics. Available Variants: Vanish Crystal White Liquid- 180ml & 800ml; Vanish Crystal White Powder - 100g & 400g.
details.usageInstructions:
Just add 1 scoop of Vanish Crystal White along with your detergent in every wash to give your white clothes a boost of shine like new & better stain removal.
For very tough stains, apply Vanish Crystal White directly on the stain and rub it before washing along with laundry detergent.

title: Oxi Action Carpet & Upholstery Stain Remover

details.description:
Vanish Oxi Action Spring Flowers Fragrance Carpet &
Upholstery Stain Remover Spray effectively tackles stubborn stains from tea,
coffee, pet urine, and soil. Its fresh spring flowers scent leaves carpets and
upholstery, smelling clean and pleasant. Easy to use, it restores fabrics to
their original brightness, making cleaning effortless and refreshing.
details.usageInstructions:
For best results treat stain immediately
Always test a hidden area of colour fastness
If carpet colour affected do not use this product
Remove loose dirt and blot wet stains with a clean absorbent cloth
Though stains may require a second application
Do not use on velvet materials, brocade, or those unsuitable for wet cleaning. Not suitable for silk and oriental rugs
